Power failures brake steadily to the shoulder, while runaway accelerators switch off and grab neutral first.
Wrong: A blowout calls for clamping the wheel and lifting off the gas.
Wrong: Failed brakes call for the parking brake first.

items.correct_rationale: Option B is correct: Power failures brake steadily to the shoulder, while runaway accelerators switch off and grab neutral first.

synthesized near-miss: a blowout
synthesized near-miss: failed brakes

items.stem: Which spot should a breakdown avoid for parking?

options.rationale: Wrong: Straight stretches are visible.
Wrong: A wide right shoulder is preferred.

options.text: Just past a crest or bend
options.rationale: Breakdowns shun crests and bends for parking, then plant flares two hundred to three hundred feet behind.

options.text: A spot visible from far away
options.rationale: Wrong: Visibility from far away is the goal.

items.correct_rationale: Option C is correct: Breakdowns shun crests and bends for parking, then plant flares two hundred to three hundred feet behind.
distractor_source: synthesized near-miss: a long straight stretch
synthesized near-miss: a wide right shoulder
synthesized near-miss: a spot visible from far away
